is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. melas) on Bubaque island.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east) (page 4, 5, 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for An. gambiae and An. gambiae/coluzzii hybrids in resistant and susceptible groups.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field on Bubaque island, Guinea-Bissau (page 2, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical study describing a survey of mosquito species composition and insecticide resistance.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for Bubaque island, with specific village locations (Anbanha, Ancadona, Bijante, Brus) mentioned (page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling was performed in June/July 2017 and November/December 2017 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific entomological investigation on Bubaque island in 2017.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Table 1, 2, 3).

assessment.summary: This study surveyed Anopheles gambiae s.l. on Bubaque island, Guinea-Bissau, in 2017. It identified An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. melas, assessed sporozoite rates, and measured insecticide resistance via CDC bottle bioassays and kdr genotyping. It found moderate resistance to alpha-cypermethrin, which was reversed by PBO, and moderate frequencies of the kdr-west (L995F) mutation.
